episodes.title: Evil Cult Tries To TRAP ME In Roblox
episodes.description:
I DIDN'T THINK A CULT WOULD TRY TO TRAP ME

Welcome to another Short Horror Game this time it's Blackthorn Lookout. In this horror game we play as a Fire Lookout. But soon a evil spooky scary cult try's to lure me out to trap me and probably eat me if we are honest here. But with my bazooka from Walmart and a can of bear spray we are gonna try and take on this Evil Roblox Cult.

If you enjoyed the video, hit LIKE and SUBSCRIBE — but more importantly, COMMENT. I genuinely love replying to you guys 💜

Thanks for watching,
– I’mLP
